# Patina integration

Modeler's refreshed interface uses the user's Patina library, created with
Fable 5.1, supplied from `C:/Users/quant/Documents/Golang UI Lib`.

- The dark surface/text palette and indigo accent come from `core/src/theme.rs`.
- Rounded controls, tonal selections, focus rings and exponential hover easing
  adapt Patina's visual design to Modeler's immediate UI and raylib 3D window.
- The September update adds all 20 named palettes from `core/src/palettes.rs`,
  embedded in `internal/ui/patina/palettes.json`, a 280 ms theme cross-fade,
  gradient surfaces, click ripples, subtle press movement and eased controls.
  Settings offers Normal, Slow and Reduced motion; preferences survive restarts.
  Mode colors retain CAD semantics and the viewport stays neutral for painting.
- Settings → Effects now exposes individual switches for glow, color cycling,
  ripples, gradients, hover lift, icon spin/pulse, SVG/path animation, entrances,
  menus, tooltips, theme transitions and library-preview rotation. Press choices
  include Subtle, Bounce, Rubber band and Gelatin; motion can use easing or
  Patina's stable, substepped Spring/Bouncy spring integration.
- Modeler renders whole-button press transformations through raylib's matrix
  stack. It does not embed the native offscreen widget renderer. Effects change
  the UI only; mode semantics, body geometry and paint stay independent.
- The orbit and beacon SVGs were authored for Modeler's Effects preview and
  rendered by the supplied Patina core's actual SMIL engine. The orbit uses
  an arc path, `mpath` and automatic tangent rotation. Two embedded 120-frame
  atlases play at 30 fps on the shared animation clock (or freeze at frame 0).
  This is playback of compiled UI assets, not arbitrary runtime SVG import.
- The SVG sources in `internal/ui/patina` come from Patina's `icons` package.
  Their embedded PNG masks were generated by Patina's own `RenderSVGTinted`
  (resvg) at 96 pixels and are cached at display size by Modeler.
- `LICENSE` retains Patina's MIT notice. Original CAD-specific icons remain.

This is a visual integration. Modeler continues to own its window, input and 3D
render loop; it does not embed Patina's separate winit/softbuffer window system.
The generated assets are included in the executable; the app needs no Patina
DLL or source directory at runtime.

To regenerate icons, run `go run .` inside `tools/patina-assets`. Its separate
module points to the supplied sibling Patina checkout. For another location,
update that module's `replace` directive and set `PATINA_LIBRARY` to the built
core DLL when necessary. Normal Modeler builds do not run this tool.

Regenerate the animated atlases with `cargo run --offline --manifest-path
tools/patina-motion/Cargo.toml`. The small tool uses Patina's public Rust
`SvgDoc::render_at` API, validates that the documents animate, and writes the
embedded PNGs. Its dependency path points to the supplied Go UI Library checkout.
Keep Cargo build output under an ignored temporary directory using
`CARGO_TARGET_DIR=testdata/tmp/patina-motion-build`.
